`multisystem_2022_2023.parquet` has the layout of `oda_reader.download_multisystem(start_year=2022, end_year=2023, filters={"donor": ...})` (oda-reader 1.11.4, dataflow DSD_MULTI@DF_MULTI 1.6) for Norway, France and the United States. It keeps every "Core contributions to" row of the three donors, the first 60 "Contributions through" rows, and the DAC and non-DAC aggregate rows (donors 20001 and 20006) for core contributions in the all-developing-countries, all-sectors cell. Codes, code-list names, years, flows, missing values and the repeated recipient and sector cells are real; the `value` column is invented, and equal figures stay equal.
